newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - MMI started as outperform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - MMI started as outperform.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said it initiated coverage of MMI Cos after the market closed on Tuesday with an outperform rating for the near (six months) and intermediate (18 months) terms.
--"The valuation of MMI stock is attractive at a price-to-earnings (PE) multiple of 10.2 times estimated 1997 earnings per share of $3 and at 8.8 times 1998 EPS of $3.47," EVEREN noted in a report.
--MMI is a medical malpractice insurance and healthcare consulting company based in Deerfield, Ill.
